menu.autodrop.name: AutoDrop
menu.autodrop.screen.title: AutoDrop
menu.autodrop.screen.mode.drop.descripti: The listed items are dropped. Protected slots and enabled keep lists always win.
menu.autodrop.screen.mode.keep.descripti: The listed items are kept and every other item is dropped. Enabled keep lists combine. You review the result before you can turn it on.
menu.autodrop.screen.items.empty: No items yet. Use “Add items…” below to choose some.
menu.autodrop.screen.profiles.empty: Create a profile with “New profile” to get started. New profiles start turned off.
menu.autodrop.screen.tooltip.unknown: Not an item in this game, so it never matches.
menu.autodrop.screen.save.description: Dropping is paused while this screen is open. Saving applies all changes.
menu.autodrop.screen.delete.title: Delete profile?
menu.autodrop.screen.delete.description: Delete “%s”? Until you save, Discard brings it back.
menu.autodrop.screen.discard.title: Discard changes?
menu.autodrop.screen.discard.description: Close AutoDrop and discard all unsaved changes?
menu.autodrop.screen.status.no_world: Join a world to preview which items would be dropped.
menu.autodrop.screen.no_inventory: Join a world to see your inventory and the preview. You can still edit profiles and settings here.
menu.autodrop.screen.any_item.descriptio: Matches every item type. Protected slots and keep lists still win.
menu.autodrop.screen.quantity.half.descr: Drops half of each matching stack, rounded up. Single items stay.
menu.autodrop.screen.quantity.exact.desc: Drops exactly X items per trigger, taken from several stacks if needed. If fewer are available, nothing is dropped.
menu.autodrop.screen.rule.exact.descript: Counted across all matching stacks, so it may be more than one stack.
menu.autodrop.screen.rule.exact.warning: The cursor can only drop whole stacks or half of a stack. If X ends partway through a stack, the rest is thrown one item at a time. That sends one packet per item, which some servers limit.
menu.autodrop.screen.rule.minimum.descri: Only drop when you carry at least this many matching items in total, protected slots included. 0 = always.
menu.autodrop.screen.rule.keep_all.descr: Keep lists protect every matching item. Amounts and minimums only apply to drop lists.
menu.autodrop.screen.rule.type.descripti: For example minecraft:stone. Use * to match every item type.
menu.autodrop.screen.rule.predicate.desc: Optional. Uses Minecraft's item predicate syntax, for example [minecraft:damage=0]. Leave empty to match any item data.
menu.autodrop.screen.rule.predicate.offl: Some filters need a world connection to be checked.
menu.autodrop.screen.picker.title: Add items to “%s”
menu.autodrop.screen.picker.inventory.de: Only show items you currently carry, including protected slots.
menu.autodrop.screen.picker.select_resul: Selects every item currently shown, except “Any item”.
menu.autodrop.screen.slots.description: Click slots to protect them. Items in protected slots are never dropped by any enabled profile. New profiles start with the armor slots protected.
menu.autodrop.screen.preview.description: What would be dropped right now, using every enabled profile of this draft. Hover a slot for details.
menu.autodrop.screen.preview.overlap: Items matching several drop rules follow every matching rule's limits, so the strictest rule decides how much drops. Keep lists combine their allowed items.
menu.autodrop.screen.preview.count: Preview: %s items from %s stacks would be dropped
menu.autodrop.screen.preview.single_item: The cursor can't split off %s items here, so they are thrown one at a time (one packet each).
%s stacks can't be split with the cursor, so their items are thrown one at a time. See Details.
menu.autodrop.screen.keep_review.title: Review keep list
menu.autodrop.screen.keep_review.descrip: “%s” keeps only its listed items. Every other item will be dropped.
menu.autodrop.screen.keep_review.details: Items in protected slots are never dropped. If several keep lists are on, an item on any of them is kept.
menu.autodrop.screen.keep_review.preview: Right now, %s items from %s stacks would be dropped:
menu.autodrop.screen.keep_review.no_worl: Join a world to preview what would be dropped. You can still turn the list on now.
menu.autodrop.screen.keep_review.master_: AutoDrop is currently off, so nothing is dropped until you turn it on in General settings.
menu.autodrop.screen.general.enabled.des: Turns all dropping on or off. Each profile also has its own switch.
menu.autodrop.screen.general.pickup.desc: Drops unwanted items right after new items land in your inventory.
menu.autodrop.screen.general.sneak.descr: Start crouching to drop unwanted items. Handy as a manual trigger; the other triggers keep working.
menu.autodrop.screen.general.key: You can also press %s (key binding “Trigger AutoDrop”) to drop unwanted items at any time.
menu.autodrop.screen.general.delay.descr: Waits this long after a trigger, so several pickups are handled together. 0 = right away.
menu.autodrop.screen.invalid.delay: The delay must be between 0 and 2147483647 ms.
menu.autodrop.screen.invalid.name: Enter a name for every profile.
menu.autodrop.screen.invalid.quantity: Use a positive X and a minimum of 0 or more. %s
menu.autodrop.screen.invalid.exact: X must be a whole number above 0.
menu.autodrop.screen.invalid.minimum: The minimum must be a whole number of 0 or more.
menu.autodrop.screen.invalid.empty_keep: Add at least one item before turning on keep list “%s”.
menu.autodrop.screen.invalid.keep_review: Review keep list “%s” before turning it on.
menu.autodrop.screen.invalid.type: Enter a registry ID such as minecraft:stone, or * for any item.
menu.autodrop.screen.save_error: Could not save; your changes are kept: %s
menu.autodrop.screen.reason.unavailable_: Unavailable in this menu, cursor occupied, or cannot be taken
menu.autodrop.screen.reason.below_minimu: %s: %s matching in inventory; requires %s before dropping
menu.autodrop.screen.reason.exact_insuff: %s: %s eligible items; needs exactly %s; batch skipped
menu.autodrop.screen.reason.batch_alloca: %s: a matching exact amount is already used up for this trigger, or half-stack mode leaves a single item
menu.autodrop.screen.reason.drop_listed: %s: listed item; %s matching items counted before this batch
menu.autodrop.screen.reason.drop_unliste: Unlisted by all enabled keep profiles: %s
menu.autodrop.screen.reason.empty_keep: An enabled keep list is empty; dropping paused
menu.autodrop.screen.reason.invalid_pred: An enabled rule has an invalid predicate; dropping paused
